owner_report: Visible Pi Annotations UI closed. Exact remaining production executable identified by approved PID-only inspection.
scope: Up to one PID-bound SIGTERM to the frozen production backend, then one new bounded preflight and conditional metadata-reader operation. No client upgrade, trust replacement, Xochitl/AppLoad/service restart, old-file cleanup, retries or SIGKILL.
stop_policy: Acquire Linux pidfd first; revalidate frozen boot, PID start, parent, process UID/GID, process-directory identity, executable path/inode/mode/size/hash. Refuse all identity mismatches. If already exited after valid capture, observe exit without a signal. Otherwise send one SIGTERM through pidfd, wait at most 10 seconds for pidfd exit readiness. No raw PID signalling, fallback, retry, escalation or service restart.
risk: The installed AppLoad backend path has no application-defined SIGTERM handler. This terminates only the identified backend, not Xochitl. The visible UI is owner-reported closed. Data files are not written by the helper. Unsupported kernel pidfd/select or uncertain exit stops the workflow and preserves the new helper.

argv:
sh -c 'set -eu
fail() { printf '\''STOP=%s\n'\'' "$1" >&2; exit 41; }
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || fail account
[ "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = '\''8e816d98-6bf4-4f9e-9abe-891fbf83d06f'\'' ] || fail boot_changed
base='\''/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge'\''
dir='\''/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-stop-0015'\''
helper='\''/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-stop-0015/stop'\''
for path in / /home /home/root /home/root/.local /home/root/.local/share "$base"; do
 [ -d "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ] || fail parent_type
 [ "$(stat -c %u "$path")" = 0 ] || fail parent_owner
done
[ "$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a'\'' "$base")" = '\''65026:1150:0:0:700'\'' ] || fail base_identity_changed
[ ! -e "$dir" ] && [ ! -L "$dir" ] || fail helper_directory_occupied
umask 077
mkdir -m 700 "$dir"
dir_identity=$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a'\'' "$dir")
set -C
cat > "$helper"
[ -f "$helper" ] && [ ! -L "$helper" ] || fail helper_type
[ "$(stat -c '\''%u:%g:%a:%s'\'' "$helper")" = '\''0:0:600:2162872'\'' ] || fail helper_metadata
printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''7d73d400086aef839109386ec581228df1eb40682aac435d12e60ffe346f3a22  /home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-stop-0015/stop'\'' | sha256sum -c -
chmod 700 "$helper"
helper_identity=$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a:%s'\'' "$helper")
printf '\''STOP_HELPER_DIRECTORY_IDENTITY=%s\nSTOP_HELPER_FILE_IDENTITY=%s\n'\'' "$dir_identity" "$helper_identity"
"$helper"
[ -d "$dir" ] && [ ! -L "$dir" ] || fail cleanup_directory_type
[ "$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a'\'' "$dir")" = "$dir_identity" ] || fail cleanup_directory_identity
[ -f "$helper" ] && [ ! -L "$helper" ] || fail cleanup_helper_type
[ "$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a:%s'\'' "$helper")" = "$helper_identity" ] || fail cleanup_helper_identity
printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''7d73d400086aef839109386ec581228df1eb40682aac435d12e60ffe346f3a22  /home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-stop-0015/stop'\'' | sha256sum -c -
rm -- "$helper"
rmdir -- "$dir"
printf '\''OWNED_STOP_HELPER_REMOVED\n'\''
'
operations.success_requires: exit 0; valid pi-ink-pidfd-stop/v1 report for PID 41472 with exit_observed true; OWNED_STOP_HELPER_REMOVED marker.
operations.on_failure: Stop immediately; retain partial helper state; no subsequent preflight, cleanup, fallback signal or retry.

operations.on_nonzero: Stop immediately; no helper staging, no retry.
operations.requires: Stop operation succeeded and its helper cleanup was observed. This is one newly authorized preflight, not an automatic retry.
Operation 2 succeeds, complete marker and frozen boot/base identity match. This is the previously prepared pinned metadata reader, not a new client install.

operations.on_nonzero_or_disconnect: Stop and preserve exact partial helper state. No retry or broader cleanup. Lost connection is not proof that the remote process stopped.

remote_write_allowlist.operation: Exclusive absent root-private 0700 helper directory; preserve on failure.
Exclusive upload; verify exact size/hash; chmod 0700; execute once; remove only after successful stop and identity/hash revalidation.
Create only if absent; root-only mode 0700. Preserve on any failure.

Exclusive new file via noclobber upload; mode 0600; verify exact size and SHA-256; chmod 0700; execute once; remove only after synchronous process return and matching inode/device/owner/mode/size and SHA-256 checks.

cleanup: Only the two newly created pinned helper files and their respective proven-empty helper directories after each successful synchronous helper run and identity/hash checks. Preserve on failure; no old file or experiment cleanup.
read_scope: Stop operation reads only process/executable metadata; preflight reads its fixed approved metadata/hash inventory; metadata reader returns hashes, identity digest and trust/path booleans without private contents.
approval_requested: Approve exactly this frozen target, the three bounded conditional operations, up to one pidfd SIGTERM and the two temporary-helper lifecycles. Keep the tablet client closed and do not restart or alter device files during execution.
